front: ADF test: null hypothesis and decision?
back: Null: unit root (non-stationary). A small p-value (below 0.05) rejects it, so the series looks stationary.

front: How is KPSS different from ADF?
back: KPSS has the opposite null: the series is stationary. Use both as a cross-check.

front: What do ACF and PACF cut-offs suggest?
back: PACF cuts off after lag p: AR(p). ACF cuts off after lag q: MA(q). Peaks at multiples of m: season length m.
STL handles any period, lets the season change slowly, has a robust mode, and gives values at the edges.
An array of k + 1 values for lags 0 to k. The value at lag 0 is 1.
